summary: Accepted the direct WASM and public-host admission repair. Own data descriptors are captured without reading accessors, reentry is fenced across ownKeys and descriptor traps, and the public host forwards original argument references before cloning results. The post-repair host probe binds current source and WASM hashes; an independently rerun direct bridge smoke passed its malformed/accessor/reentry/valid-after-error cases. Original pre-repair evidence remains. No host suite or full runner was rerun; no integrated pass is claimed.
